selection_reason: High-reuse absent card using existing qualified primitives: stack spell targeting, counter effect, target-controller token creation, blue Bird token with flying. No new engine subsystem or pilot strategy.
reusable_primitives: An Offer You Can't Refuse: create tokens for target spell controller then counter
Murmuring Mystic/Pongify: flying creature token creation
TargetSpell + composable TargetFilter over stack card types

rules: Counter target enchantment, instant, or sorcery spell.
Its controller creates a 2/2 blue Bird creature token with flying.

qualification_cases: Counter an instant; its controller receives exactly one 2/2 blue Bird with flying.
Counter an enchantment; its controller receives the Bird.
Reject a creature spell as an illegal target.
Reject an artifact spell as an illegal target.
adoption_rule: Definition/test/snapshot adoption only after changed-source review plus fresh bounded mechanics qualification and one-time audit.
